Questions people ask first.

Bolton and the North WestLBL is based in Bolton and works across the surrounding areas. 9 Prescott St, Bolton BL3 3LZ.

Do you serve areas beyond Bolton?

Yes. LBL is based in Bolton and also serves surrounding areas across the North West.

What types of roofs do you work on?

All kinds: pitched roofs, flat roofs, slate roofs and tile roofs.

Do you offer emergency roof repairs?

Yes. LBL provides a prompt emergency roof repair service to keep your home safe.
